reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new zonelist type for private nodes, which is intended to improve performance by reducing complexity and allowing for more efficient memory allocation. However, the patch author has posted two identical messages with no discussion or feedback.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new zonelist type, ZONELIST_PRIVATE, which allows private nodes to have their own local zones without relying on the existing FALLBACK and NOFALLBACK zonelists. This change is intended to improve performance by reducing complexity and allowing for more efficient memory allocation.
